item.text: The doc at `Raft::install_snapshot` states an older-than-state-machine snapshot is ignored; the engine only compares against the last snapshot. I'll test that contract directly with an engine-level repro.
The suspicion is refuted: `FollowingHandler::install_full_snapshot()` does guard `snapshot_last_log_id <= committed` before touching state. I'll correct the report so it doesn't carry a false lead.

item.text:
This turn closed out the stale-snapshot lead and corrected the report.

What I did:

- Traced the snapshot installation path end-to-end after the earlier concern that only the last snapshot was compared: `FollowingHandler::install_full_snapshot()` first rejects any snapshot with `last_log_id <= state.committed()` (`engine/handler/following_handler/mod.rs:284`), before touching `committed`, membership, or the state machine. `Raft::install_snapshot()` additionally rejects older votes. The suspicion was wrong.
- Verified with the checked-in regression test: `cargo test -p openraft --lib test_install_snapshot_lt_committed` passes; output saved to `audit/logs/install-snapshot-lt-committed-check.txt`.
- Reworked the `update_committed` model rationale in the report: its "valid snapshot" premise is now backed by that local committed guard, not just a protocol argument, and the refuted suspicion is documented as an alternative explanation that was checked.

No new defect was confirmed, so the confirmed set remains the 11 findings (F1–F11). The report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md) is current: findings, final library counts (197 default / 197 storage-v2 / 199 compat,serde / 208 generic-snapshot-data), verified model invariants, and the artifact/command list all reflect the current state.
